summary: HUYA Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, US-listed (Form 6-K, 1934 Act) Chinese live-streaming company, disclosed that its board approved an amended and restated 2024 Share Incentive Plan effective 4 November 2026. The aggregate Class A ordinary shares reserved for awards rose from 15,846,000 to 31,749,372, with all other terms substantially unchanged and prior awards assumed. No price, premium, stake, advisor, or transaction deadline is stated. The change is a routine equity-compensation capacity increase, not a special situation; dilution from the enlarged reserve is the only item for watch.
